name: hh-arc
notes: Hopping Heads Arc game server. Env (PORT, DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CHAIN_ID, ARC_RPC_URL, EXPLORER_URL, ESCROW_ADDRESS) lives in Pier, never in the repo; see .env.example. This process holds no key: it reads the escrow over a public RPC. The signer (services/signer) and the settlement worker (services/settler) are their own Pier services with their own env blocks and pinned commits. The contracts gate step skips with a notice when arc-forge is not on PATH.
